'''Garoush''' was a wealthy [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]]. He was present in a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] in the [[Issagra space station|space station]] at [[Issagra]] when a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who were avoiding [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] arrived. He took great interest in them, and offered to bail them out of trouble in exchange for them performing a service for him in the future.
